Compute the stagnation-to-static pressure ratio for a subsonic flow with Mach number M = 0.5 using the isentropic flow relations (Saint-Venant), not the Rayleigh-Pitot formula.
The Rayleigh-Pitot formula is not applicable because subsonic flow cannot form a shock.
Use the isentropic relation: p₀/p = (1 + ((γ−1)/2) · M²)^(γ/(γ−1)).
Use the standard value for air, γ = 1.4.
Substitute M = 0.5 and γ = 1.4 into the relation: p₀/p = (1 + 0.2 · 0.25)^(3.5) = (1.05)^3.5.
Report the numerical result to an appropriate number of significant figures (approximately 1.186).
State clearly that the result is the stagnation-to-static pressure ratio p₀/p for isentropic subsonic flow.
